usedFor: A conversion in Google Analytics opens a deal in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “Conversion Event Created” in Google Analytics, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A conversion is the moment worth a deal, and “Create Deal” puts it in the pipeline.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email and “Update Company” a company ID, so check the conversion event provides them.
